title: SnailSploit/Claude-Red
title_zh: claude-red 开发 Offensive 安全技能库

paragraphs.en: claude-red is a curated library of offensive security skills designed for the Claude skills system. Each skill is a structured SKILL.md file that primes Claude with expert-level methodology for a specific attack surface — from SQLi to shellcode, EDR evasion to exploit development.
paragraphs.zh: claude-red 是一个为 Claude 技能系统设计的、经过精心整理的攻击性安全技能库。 每个技能都是一个结构化的 SKILL.md 文件，为 Claude 预置针对特定攻击面的专家级方法论——从 SQLi 到 shellcode，从 EDR 规避到漏洞利用开发。

paragraphs.en: Offensive security skills for Claude — drop-in SKILL.md files that turn Claude into a context-aware red team operator.
paragraphs.zh: 面向 Claude 的进攻性安全技能——即插即用的 SKILL.md 文件，可将 Claude 变成具备上下文感知能力的红队操作员（智能体）。

paragraphs.en: claude-red is a curated library of offensive security skills for the Claude Skills system . Each skill is a structured SKILL.md file that primes Claude with expert-level methodology for a specific attack surface — from SQL injection to shellcode, EDR evasion to ADCS abuse.
paragraphs.zh: claude-red 是一个为 Claude Skills 系统精选的进攻性安全技能库。 每个技能都是一个结构化的 SKILL.md 文件，让 Claude 预先掌握针对特定攻击面的专家级方法论——从 SQL 注入到 shellcode，从 EDR 规避到 ADCS 滥用。

sents.en: Each skill is a structured SKILL.md file that primes Claude with expert-level methodology for a specific attack surface — from SQL injection to shellcode, EDR evasion to ADCS abuse.

paragraphs.en: Drop a skill into your Claude environment and it behaves like a domain specialist: it knows the techniques, the tooling, the edge cases, and the escalation paths. Skills load on demand based on conversational triggers — you don't pay context for skills you aren't using.
paragraphs.zh: 把一个技能放入你的 Claude 环境中，它就会像一个领域专家那样工作：它掌握相关技术、工具、边缘情况以及升级处理路径。 技能会根据对话触发条件按需加载——你不需要为未使用的技能付出上下文代价。

paragraphs.en: Use cases: authorized red team engagements, bug bounty triage, security research, CTF preparation, operator training, and methodical attack surface exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 用例：授权的红队测试、漏洞赏金分类、安全研究、CTF 备赛、操作员培训，以及系统性的攻击面探索。

paragraphs.en: git clone https://github.com/SnailSploit/claude-red ~ /.claude/skills/claude-red Claude auto-loads matching skills based on conversational triggers (e.g., mentioning SQL injection loads offensive-sqli ).
paragraphs.zh: git clone https://github.com/SnailSploit/claude-red ~ /.claude/skills/claude-red Claude 会根据对话触发条件自动加载匹配的技能（例如，提到 SQL 注入就会加载 offensive-sqli）。

paragraphs.en: git clone --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/SnailSploit/claude-red cd claude-red && git sparse-checkout set Skills/web Skills/active-directory Claude Code cat Skills/web/offensive-sqli/SKILL.md | claude --system-file - cat Skills/active-directory/ ** /SKILL.md | claude --system-file - Claude.ai (Manual) Paste the contents of a SKILL.md into a Project's system prompt or prepend it to your conversation.
paragraphs.zh: git clone --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/SnailSploit/claude-red cd claude-red && git sparse-checkout set Skills/web Skills/active-directory Claude Code cat Skills/web/offensive-sqli/SKILL.md | claude --system-file - cat Skills/active-directory/ ** /SKILL.md | claude --system-file - Claude.ai（手动方式）将 SKILL.md 的内容粘贴到项目的系统提示词中，或将其添加到对话的开头。
